evals.prompt: この大きめのリファクタリングを段階的に進めたい。planner と reviewer を挟んで
evals.expected_output: Uses the orchestrate skill and plans a phased workflow with explicit review checkpoints rather than doing a single straight-line implementation.

evals.prompt: このバグ修正を複数フェーズで安全に進めるならどう組む？
evals.expected_output: Leans toward orchestrate when the user explicitly asks for phased execution or safety-oriented sequencing, even if implementation has not started yet.

evals.prompt: この単一ファイルの小さな修正をやって
evals.expected_output: Does not use the orchestrate skill for a simple low-risk edit that does not justify a staged multi-phase workflow.
